operations.name: GetServiceCapabilities
operations.description: Returns the capabilities of the thermal service. The result is returned in a typed answer.

fields.name: Capabilities

attributes.name: Radiometry
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not radiometric thermal measurements are supported by the thermal device.

fields.description: The capabilities of the thermal service are returned in the Capabilities element.

operations.name: GetConfigurationOptions
operations.description: Gets the valid ranges for the Thermal parameters that have device specific ranges. This command is mandatory for all devices implementing the Thermal service. The command shall return all supported parameters and their ranges, such that these can be applied to the SetConfiguration command.

fields.name: VideoSourceToken

definition.name: ReferenceToken
definition.description:
Unique identifier for a physical or logical resource.
			Tokens should be assigned such that they are unique within a device. Tokens must be at least unique within its class.
			Length up to 64 characters. Token may be extended by intermediate terminal with adding prefix to make it global unique.
			The length should be within 36 characters for generating at local device. See "Remote Token" section in Resource Query specification.

fields.description: Reference token to the VideoSource for which the Thermal Configuration Options are requested.

operations.name: GetRadiometryConfiguration
operations.description: Gets the Radiometry Configuration for the requested VideoSource.

fields.name: VideoSourceToken

definition.name: ReferenceToken
definition.description:
Unique identifier for a physical or logical resource.
			Tokens should be assigned such that they are unique within a device. Tokens must be at least unique within its class.
			Length up to 64 characters. Token may be extended by intermediate terminal with adding prefix to make it global unique.
			The length should be within 36 characters for generating at local device. See "Remote Token" section in Resource Query specification.

fields.description: Reference token to the VideoSource for which the Radiometry Configuration is requested.

fields.name: Configuration
RadiometryGlobalParameters

definition.name: RadiometryGlobalParameters
definition.description:
Holds default values that will be used in measurement modules when local parameters are not specified for the module (these are still required for valid temperature calculations). 
						Having ReflectedAmbientTemperature, Emissivity and DistanceToObject as mandatory ensures minimum parameters are available to obtain valid temperature values.

fields.name: ReflectedAmbientTemperature
fields.description: Reflected Ambient Temperature for the environment in which the thermal device and the object being measured is located.

fields.name: Emissivity
fields.description: Emissivity of the surface of the object on which temperature is being measured.

fields.name: DistanceToObject
fields.description: Distance from the thermal device to the measured object.

fields.name: RelativeHumidity
fields.description: Relative Humidity in the environment in which the measurement is located.

fields.name: AtmosphericTemperature
fields.description: Temperature of the atmosphere between the thermal device and the object being measured.

fields.name: AtmosphericTransmittance
fields.description: Transmittance value for the atmosphere between the thermal device and the object being measured.

fields.name: ExtOpticsTemperature
fields.description: Temperature of the optics elements between the thermal device and the object being measured.

fields.name: ExtOpticsTransmittance
fields.description: Transmittance value for the optics elements between the thermal device and the object being measured.

Global Parameters for Radiometry Measurements. Shall exist if Radiometry Capability is reported, 
								and Global Parameters are supported by the device.
Radiometry Configuration for the VideoSource that was requested.
